title: Adding Numbers up to 100 without Regrouping
seo_title: Grade 1 Adding within 100 Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 1)
standard_text: Add numbers by expressing addends as tens and ones (expanded form); add numbers with sums up to 100 without regrouping, using a variety of concrete and pictorial models for: a. 2-digit and 1-digit numbers, and b. 2-digit and 2-digit numbers; solve problems (given orally or in pictures) involving addition with sums up to 100 without regrouping.
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 worksheets on adding within 100 without regrouping for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: tens and ones, expanded form and word problems. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Ones with ones, tens with tens.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Add the ones to the ones and the tens to the tens.
  • 34 + 5: 4 + 5 = 9 ones, 3 tens. The answer is 39.
  • 34 + 25: 4 + 5 = 9 ones, 3 + 2 = 5 tens. The answer is 59.
  • Expanded form: 34 + 25 = 30 + 4 + 20 + 5 = 50 + 9 = 59.

Examples

Example

42 + 36

ones: 2 + 6 = 8

tens: 4 + 3 = 7

Answer: 78

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Ones added to tensLine up ones with ones.
Adding all the digits34 + 25 is not 3 + 4 + 2 + 5.
Forgetting the tensAdd the tens too.

faq.a: Add numbers by expressing addends as tens and ones, add numbers with sums up to 100 without regrouping (2-digit and 1-digit, 2-digit and 2-digit), and solve problems.
Changing 10 ones into 1 ten. Grade 1 sums do not need it.
